title: Malicious code in @noinheritdoc/n (npm)
description: The npm package @noinheritdoc/n contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removal of the package does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by the package.
